name: Silverstone
notes: Silverstone Arena Grand Prix layout from 2011 (clockwise). Raceway loop. Traced 5827 m vs 5891 m. Start line on the Hamilton Straight between Club and Abbey, level with the Wing. One DRS zone on the Wellington Straight as in 2012. Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
